page.overview:
Who is Kakarot?

As Kakarot is essentially Goku if he never experienced his head injury, he wears Saiyan Battle Armor (similar to Bulma's model created during the Cell Saga) instead of Goku's trademark orange gi. Other than this, he is Goku's spitting image.

Unlike his other counterparts, Kakarot apparently retains the memories of his early life and never took the name Goku in his timeline, which is the reason for his choice in clothing.

Kakarot is tracked down by Future Zamasu and Dr. Lychee, who wish to exterminate him - recognizing him as the son of "Mask". However, Bardock, who has been released from brainwashing, comes to aid Kakarot. Bardock and Kakarot defeat the duo together, before Bardock leaves - telling Kakarot to get stronger.

;Video Games In Ultimate Mission X, Kakarot is noted by Future Zamasu and Dr. Lychee to not be as strong as Bardock. When paired up with Bardock, the two of them together are able to defeat the tag team of Zamasu and Lychee.
